mechanism.description: Severe tachypnea (RR > 30) reflects profound metabolic acidosis. In highly acidic environments, the enzymatic activity of the coagulation cascade is impaired, potentially reducing the efficacy of TXA-mediated clot stabilization.
High RR is a proxy for global physiologic exhaustion; similar to HR and GCS, it identifies a high-severity subgroup where mortality is high regardless of TXA administration.
